item.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general
item.description: In a 50-49 vote early Saturday, the Senate confirmed President Trump's former defense lawyer as attorney general.

item.title: Child among four killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine
item.description: Debris from attacks sparked fires near Kyiv, killing at least four people, including a child.

item.title: The Uplift: Hot ones
item.description: Vladimir Duthiers interviews Sean Evans, host of "Hot Ones," where celebrities answer questions while eating spicy wings.

item.title: Houthis intensify attacks on Saudi-backed forces in Yemen
item.description: Yemeni state media reports fresh Houthi attacks on Saudi-backed troops, as Cruz urges Trump to seek "regime collapse."
